sessions.phase_label: Initial CAD layer preparation and delivery
Primary and secondary CAD layer revisions

requirements.title: Primary CAD Layer
requirements.definition: Provide and revise the independently editable primary CAD layer for the charger project.
requirements.boundary_note: The primary layer is independently delivered and receives its own edits, so it remains separate from the secondary layer; the unavailable referenced files prevent discovery of more specific attributes.

requirements.title: Secondary CAD Layer
requirements.definition: Provide and revise the independently editable secondary CAD layer for the charger project.
requirements.boundary_note: The secondary layer receives a distinct revision request and can evolve independently from the primary layer; the unavailable referenced files prevent discovery of more specific attributes.

unresolved_candidates.description: The messages refer to supplied primary files and revision materials whose contents are unavailable, so the detailed CAD specifications and revision attributes cannot be determined safely.
